prompts.name: Cubo de dados à direita
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 16:9 landscape background for academic slides with editable text added later. Restrained crisp 8-bit pixel art, sharp square pixels, deep flat midnight navy #09121F background, cyan/mint #86F6CD with subtle violet accents. No words, letters, numbers, equations, axes labels, logos, panels, borders or watermark. Decoration is abstract and not scientific evidence. Leave the top 90 pixels and bottom 65 pixels empty. The large text area must be a completely clean almost solid dark background with no bright shapes or fine textures. Place one compact elegant isometric pixel DATA CUBE, made of sparse separated glowing voxel data points and a few short connecting trails, entirely within the far RIGHT 22 percent of the canvas. Keep the LEFT 76 percent empty dark space for text. The cube should be a small vertical visual accent, not a large centerpiece. Sophisticated retro-computing mood, no robot, no room.
